system.story: Cyber-silence and chameleon; the one who is simply not there.

description.value:
Method: Ghost. How you disappear: you are never where they look.

Untouchable

Your Fade improves - it needs less cover and grants a longer shift. While you are hidden, enemies take a bane to find you or nearby hidden allies.

Bonus skill and contact

You gain Athletics or Acrobatics and a fixer contact.

Favored Kits

Ghost, Mantis (cyber-silence / chameleon build).
